question: Baking soda is ______
solution:
The correct answer is __NaHCO____3__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The common name of Sodium bicarbonate is Baking soda.
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is non flammable.
 
• Baking soda is basic in nature.
 
• Uses of Sodium bicarbonate are the following:-
 
 
• It acts as an antacid that is used to treat stomach
 
• It is used in fire extinguishers due to the formation of soapy foam
 
• It acts as a pesticide
 
• It neutralizes the effect of acid as a neutralizer
 
• In the stomach, Reduces the acidity 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__ **

__
 
• Baking soda was first manufactured by French chemist Nicolas Leblanc.
 
• It was first manufactured in 1971.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Some popular chemicals are as below-

 
• Bleaching Powder - Calcium Chlorohypochlorite
 
• Caustic Soda - Sodium Hydroxide
 
• Washing Soda - Sodium Carbonate
 
• Table Salt - Sodium Chloride
